## Open-Source Scientific Software

I develop open-source software tools for NV-center quantum sensing experiments, with a focus on
modularity, instrument abstraction, and reproducibility. The goal is to make experimental control
accessible and extensible for the broader quantum sensing community.

---

## NV Control Framework

::: {.project-card}

### NV Control Framework <span class="status-badge status-active">🟢 Active Development</span>

A modular Python framework for automated control and execution of NV-center quantum sensing
experiments. Built around a clean instrument-abstraction layer that separates hardware drivers
from experiment logic — making it straightforward to add new instruments or measurement protocols
without touching existing code.

**Tech stack**

| Component | Tool |
|---|---|
| Language | Python |
| GUI | PyQt6 |
| Instrument I/O | VISA (pyvisa) |
| Pulse control | Swabian Pulse Streamer 8/2 |
| Real-time control | Quantum Machines OPX |
| Imaging | Andor Neo 5.5 sCMOS |
| Positioning | SmarAct closed-loop stages |
| Signal generation | SRS SG386 |

**Experiments**

| Measurement | Status |
|---|---|
| ODMR (CW & pulsed) | ✅ Implemented |
| Zero-field experiment (ZFE) | ✅ Implemented |
| Rabi oscillations | 🔧 In progress |
| Ramsey spectroscopy | 📋 Planned |
| T₁ relaxometry | 📋 Planned |
| T₂ / spin echo | 📋 Planned |
